plain: Very poor; lacking the means to meet basic needs.

webster.text: Destitute of property or means of comfortable subsistence; needy; poor.

example.quote: He said there was no more reason that a great individual State contributing much, should have more votes than a small one contributing little, than that a rich individual citizen should have more votes than an indigent one.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 9, 1787
